messages.text:
That confirms npm is failing when it tries to run a lifecycle script from a nested package directory that gets pruned during resolution.

Since the app no longer needs native install scripts, I’m installing with scripts disabled and will verify whether Vite’s esbuild binary is present afterward.

commands.commandLine: "C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command '$root=(Resolve-Path .).Path; $nm=(Join-Path $root '"'node_modules'); "'$pl=(Join-Path $root '"'package-lock.json'); if((Test-Path "'$nm) -and ((Resolve-Path $nm).Path.StartsWith($root))){ Rename-Item -LiteralPath $nm -NewName ('"'node_modules.bad.' + [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds()) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; if(Test-Path "'$pl){ Remove-Item -LiteralPath $pl -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; npm install --ignore-scripts'
